title: SEATO combined fire-support demonstration

paragraphs.text: On 16 September, units of Regimental Landing Team Five conducted a combined fire-support exercise for military representatives of the Southeast Asia Treaty Organization (SEATO). The battalion provided the ground maneuver element.

notes: The report does not identify the participating 2/5 companies or an exact demonstration site.
